chunks: I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) saying: “The zanādiqah will appear in the year one hundred and twenty-eight, and that is because I looked into the Muṣḥaf of Fāṭimah (عليها السلام).” He said: I said, “And what is the Muṣḥaf of Fāṭimah?”

He said: “When Allah, the Exalted, took His Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله), there entered upon Fāṭimah (عليها السلام), due to his passing, such grief as none knows except Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. So Allah sent to her an angel to console her sorrow and speak to her. She mentioned that to Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام), and he said: ‘When you sense that and hear the voice, tell me.’”

So she informed him of that, and Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) began writing everything that he heard until he compiled from that a Muṣḥaf. He said: Then he said: ‘Indeed, there is nothing in it of the halal and the haram, but in it is the knowledge of what will be.’”

key_terms.الزَّنَادِقَةُ: those described here as heretics who would appear in a specified year
key_terms.الْحَلَالِ وَالْحَرَامِ: legal categories of what is permissible and forbidden, which the Muṣḥaf did not contain
key_terms.عِلْمُ مَا يَكُونُ: knowledge of what is going to happen in the future
key_terms.غَمَّهَا: her sorrow and grief after the Prophet’s passing
key_terms.مَلَكًا: an angel sent by Allah to console and speak to her
key_terms.مُصْحَفِ فَاطِمَةَ: the written compilation associated with Fāṭimah (عليها السلام)

ai.seo_question: What is the Muṣḥaf of Fāṭimah (عليها السلام) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the Muṣḥaf of Fāṭimah (عليها السلام) as a written record produced after the passing of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله), through what an angel conveyed to console her and what Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) wrote down. It clarifies that this Muṣḥaf did not contain halal and haram rulings, but rather knowledge of future events.
